description: CI: 240 fps capture of toss to bounce, re-timed to 30 fps media (timeScale 0.125), 540x960

extrinsics.note: X_cam = R * X_court + t; camera axes x right, y down, z forward (OpenCV). Per-frame values are in frames[].camera when shake is on.

settings.exposureTiming: frame time = centre of a global-shutter exposure (no rolling shutter)

motionBlur.ball: continuous streak over the shutter time

coordinateSystems.court: metres; origin at the centre mark on the outer edge of the server's baseline; +x toward the net, +y to the server's left when facing the net, +z up
coordinateSystems.image: x, y normalised to [0,1] with origin at the top-left of the displayed frame; landmark z = MediaPipe-style depth relative to the hip midpoint in the same scale as x (negative = closer to the camera)
coordinateSystems.time: tReal = real seconds since the centre of frame 0's exposure; tMedia = container time = tReal / timeScale

audio.note: Each sound is placed at arrivalTMedia = (emit time + distance / 343 m/s) / timeScale; shapes are not time-stretched in slow-motion media.
